Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 Must be first field in message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following BodyLength field up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Must be second field in message.

Field.Name: MesSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for session.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be third field in message. 0 = HeartBeat 1 = TestRequest 2 = Resend/Request 3 = Reject 4 = SequenceReset 5 = Logout 8 = ExecutionReport 9 = OrderCancelReject A = Logon D = NewOrderSingle F = OrderCancelRequest G = OrderCancelReplaceRequest

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Standard FIX session IDs. Assigned per-connection

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Standard FIX session IDs. Assigned per-connection

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time in UTC format YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.sss; where sss = milliseconds

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompId
Field.Description: NSSC MPID identifying the client sending order

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Trader sending message

Field.Name: DeliverToCompId
Field.Description: Identifies subscriber on messages from OTC Link ECN, and 'OTCX' on messages to OTC Link ECN.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubId
Field.Description: Identifies trader on messages from OTC Link ECN.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Reflected back on Execution Reports associated with this order. Can be used for clearing, max 40 characters.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique for all orders sent today, max 40 characters.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Valid values (space delimited): 1 = Not Held (accepted, but not processed) f = ISO h = External Routing Not Allowed 6 = Post Only on Order Entry M = Midpoint Peg (requires 40 = P) R = Primary Peg (requires 40 = P) r = Route IOC l (lowercase L) = Route IOC to OTC Link ATS Only a = Self Trade Prevention c = Ignore Erroneous Price Check o = Route ISO p = Ping ISO n = Route Outside Normal Market Hours S = Allow Price Sliding x = IOC after Cancel / Replace A = No Cross i = Imbalance Only LOC order (requires 59 = 7 and 40 = 2) If tag 18 is blank or absent, a marketable order with a TIF of Day can remove liquidity on entry by either matching a posted ECN order, or routing out to OTC Link ATS or external IDQS quotes.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares, max value of 99,999,999

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Valid value: 1 = Market (requires 59 = 7) 2 = Limit P = Pegged (requires 18 = M or R)

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of order, max allowed price of $99,999,999

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Valid values: A = Agency P = Principal R = Riskless Principal

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Valid values: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell 5 = Sell short

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: This field must contain a valid symbol in upper case lettering, max 14 characters.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Valid values: 0 = Day (Default) 3 = IOC** 5 = GTX 1 = GTC 7 = At the Close (OC)

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Portion of OrderQty to display. The balance is reserve. Zero indicates the order is fully hidden. Non-zero MaxFloor must be >= minimum quote size.

Field.Name: LocateReqd
Field.Description: Valid values: Y = Yes N = No Required to be N for sell short orders. Rejected if Y or absent.

Field.Name: NoTradingSessions
Field.Description: 1, 2 or 3 [Must come before 336 Tag(s). Will be ignored if tag 59 not = GTX or GTC.]

Field.Name: LocateBroker
Field.Description: Locate MPID

Field.Name: NoSelfTrade
Field.Description: Only applicable when 18 = a. Valid values: D = Cancel Smaller/Decrement Larger (Default) N = Cancel Newest O = Cancel Oldest C = Cancel Both

Field.Name: RefreshBelowShow
Field.Description: Flag indicating when reserve order will refresh; below minimum quote size or below MaxFloor (Show size). Valid values: Y = Below MaxFloor N = Below Minimum Quote Size (Default)

Field.Name: UnsolicitedFlag
Field.Description: Valid values: Y = Order is unsolicited N = Order is not unsolicited (Default)

Field.Name: NonAffliiateFlag
Field.Description: Flag indicating unsolicited order is from a non-affiliate. Y = Unsolicited order is from a Non-Affiliate N = Unsolicited order is not from a Non-Affiliate (Default)

Field.Description: This field contains the ID assigned to the message by your firm. A unique identifier, max 40 characters.
